items.title: Housing Costs Keep Buyers Renting, and $90,000 Across These 3 Housing REITs Pays $3,522 a Year
items.summary: With mortgage rates stuck above 7% and home sales at a one-year low, millions of would-be buyers keep writing rent checks. Three landlords are collecting them, and one rents houses to the very families priced out of buying.
